about: Deterministic render-cost budgets per add-on (qa/lib/budget.js). Shape: { "<module id>": { "<exact check label>": { "passes": n, "calls": n, "tris": fraction<1 or n, "programs": n, "compiles": n, "textures": n, "texMB": n } } }. Each value = how much MORE the module may cost than the same page without it (module on vs off, same camera). The budget written in the test is the default; an entry here overrides it (tune budgets without touching tests). Metrics are counts, identical on SwiftShader and a real GPU; frame-time / GPU-ms checks stay on the PC (perf lane / GPU attestation).
